semantics.edge: Update on rising clk edge; synchronous register behavior assumed because polarity is unstated.
semantics.priority: Active-high load replaces q with data, regardless of ena or amount, instead of shifting.
semantics.shift: If load is low and ena high: 00 left 1, 01 left 8, 10 arithmetic right 1, 11 arithmetic right 8.
semantics.hold: If load and ena are low, retain q.
semantics.initialization: No initial value specified; no initializer or reset is added. Verification establishes known state by loading.

numeric.left: Zero fill low bits and discard high bits beyond 64.
numeric.right: Replicate original q[63] into vacated high bits for arithmetic shifts.
numeric.amount: Two-bit direction/distance selector, not a numeric shift count.

verification.oracle: Independent bit-by-bit movement from prior expected state, derived from original shift definitions.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges, check retention before rising edge, sample after rising edge NBA updates.
verification.directed: Load priority, disabled hold, all selectors, positive and negative data, zero, all ones, boundary bits, repeated shifts.
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random loads, holds and shifts.
verification.termination: Fatal mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all comparisons.

specification_ambiguities: Clock edge polarity is not explicitly stated; rising-edge operation is assumed.
Power-up contents are unspecified; tests do not require a particular initial value before the first load.
